messages:
Elena Park: Heads-up — live demo for Bexly just hit a blocker. Their structured-output + function calling setup keeps failing schema validation with an 'invalid JSON' from our side during the demo. Anyone available to triage?
Mike Chen: On it. Do we have the raw model response + request payload (sanitized)?
Elena Park: Pasting a short excerpt from their logs (sanitized). They said it worked in staging but now in demo it's failing: 
```
Response: {"order_id":"1234","items":[{"sku":"A1","qty":2},{"sku":"B2","qty":1}],"total":59.99
... (truncated)
JSONParseError: Unexpected end of input at position 112
```
Elena Park: They were using JSON mode + function_call name=create_order. It looks like the response is getting cut mid-object.
Samir Rao: Truncation sounds likely. Which model/variant? Also did they use streaming? Truncation + streaming -> client must reassemble chunks before schema validation.
Elena Park: They reported model redwood/gptx-1.4q hosted. ops-bot spat a 429 during the demo window.
ops-bot: Rate limit exceeded for org bexly-co — throttle window 30s (burst quota applied).
Tanner Ng: If streaming is enabled, the validator runs after the full stream is reassembled. If a connection closes early we get partial JSON. Can you share the API payload (no keys) so we can check max_response_tokens / streaming flags?
Elena Park: Here's the sanitized curl they used: 
```
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -d '{"model":"redwood/gptx-1.4q","stream":true,"max_response_tokens":256,"function_call":{"name":"create_order","arguments_schema":{...}}}'
```
Mike Chen: Two quick things: 1) If stream=true and the client doesn't concat properly you get partial JSON. 2) If they hit 429s the server may close the stream mid-response. Workarounds: set stream=false OR increase max_response_tokens and handle retries.
Samir Rao: Also flagging an internal edge-case: our streamed reassembly validator can choke on trailing commas introduced during chunk boundaries — created ticket RT-3948. Workaround for customers: turn streaming off or post-process to strip a trailing comma before validation.
Avery Cole: Customer asked whether Dedicated would avoid this spike and if we can fast-track an eval for their POC — pricing & SLA question. I can offer a 2-week dedicated eval on a small pool but need ARR/SE sign-off. Elena, can you send estimated usage?
Elena Park: Sent details in DM. Quick patch during demo: set stream=false and bump max_response_tokens to 1024 — demo resumed and validator passed. Bexly is back on the call.
Tanner Ng: Long-term fixes: a) improve stream reassembly to tolerate boundary commas (ENG plan RT-3948), b) add clearer API error for truncated streams vs schema mismatch, c) update docs with recommended settings for function_call + big JSON outputs.
Mike Chen: Customer question about pricing if they move to Dedicated to avoid throttles — Avery will scope. Also flagged we should add a KB entry for 'function_call + streaming best practices' to reduce SE time.
Elena Park: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the customer on Dedicated eval and confirm whether they want engineering access for the RT-3948 workaround. For now demo is green. :tada:
Avery Cole: I'll start the pricing piece and loop in sales ops.
deploy-bot: Created ticket RT-3948 assigned to eng-runtime.
Elena Park: Closing loop here — dropping final notes into the CRM and marking the POC as 'demo recovered'.
